newsitem.title: USA: Calif. manufacturers back $1 bln tax cut plan.
newsitem.headline: Calif. manufacturers back $1 bln tax cut plan.

text.p: California manufacturers on Thursday endorsed Gov. Pete Wilson's $1 billion personal income tax cut proposal.

The Republican governor's proposal would increase the current tax-bracket ceiling by 10 percent beginning with the 1999 tax year. He said his proposal would allow a single taxpayer earning $40,000 a year to receive a $166 tax cut, and a couple earning a combined $80,000 to get a $332 tax break.
In a statement, William Campbell, president of the California Manufacturers Association, said the tax cut plan would benefit thousands of small manufacturers in the state.
"By providing additional capitol for investment, this tax reduction will continue California's economic expansion and help create thousands of new jobs," Campbell said.
